description: Inspection excerpts from the RainNet archive, one 20-frame window per file (10 input hours + 10 target hours), raw mm values.
normalization_note: benchmark inputs are clip[0, 140] mm then /140 (rainnet_build_lowres.py); apply before model use
selection_rule: scan every 20-frame window of the month; keep the 3 non-overlapping windows with the highest mean target rain rate (frames 10..19; greedy down the ranking) and the 2 closest to the month median of that statistic (ties resolved by earlier start hour)
source_archive: RainNet_HDF5.zip (Chen et al. 2022, distributed under CC BY; download from https://github.com/neuralchen/RainNet)
split_note: these excerpts are not part of any train/validation/test split and are not used by any evaluation in the paper

windows.unit: mm, raw archive values (no normalization applied)
